title: Session commands are never blocked by the auto-mode classifier: genlock's PreToolUse hooks allow swap/open/close/spinoff launch outright

requirements.text: genlock guard and genlock session-state print a PreToolUse permissionDecision allow for any Bash command made only of genlock calls plus harmless plumbing (cd, head, tail, 2>&1, ;, &&, |)
Commands mixing in anything else (rm, git, $( ), backticks, redirects to files) get no allow from the hook
A headless auto-mode claude session whose transcript gives no user approval runs a compound genlock swap with no classifier denial, with the hook; the same command is denied without it
requirements.check: manual: claude -p --permission-mode auto in scratchpad, permission_denials in json output

requirements.text: Installed app and every project's guard use the new code (globally installed genlock on PATH updated)
requirements.check: manual: which genlock; echo payload | genlock guard prints allow

evidence: tests/run.mjs 605 passed 0 failed; guard and session-state each allow 9 genlock-only shapes incl. the 3 denied nightmaremode commands (pipes, ; chains, quoted ; | >)
tests/run.mjs: 13 mixed commands (rm, git push, $( ), backticks, > file, PATH=, &, | sh, bash -c, heredoc, subshell, unterminated quote, plumbing-only) get no decision from either hook

claude -p sonnet --permission-mode auto, scratchpad stub genlock, 'genlock followups | tail; genlock swap G-3FPGE | tail': no hook -> permissionDecisionMs=1515 (classifier consulted); with guard hook -> 'Hook result has permissionBehavior=allow', permissionDecisionMs=14 (classifier skipped). Control did not produce a denial (classifier passed it), so proof is the skipped call, not a flipped verdict

global genlock symlinks to this repo; /Applications/Genlock.app/Contents/Resources/genlock/lib/allow.mjs identical to repo (diff -q); bundled run/genlock guard in /Users/tj/nightmaremode prints allow for a piped swap, nothing for 'genlock swap; rm -rf x'

answers.observed: debug log: hook run permissionBehavior=allow, permissionDecisionMs=14 vs 1515 without; 10 classifier denials in nightmaremode transcripts, all compound genlock commands
answers.cause: measured: hook allow short-circuits the classifier. Hypothesis only: why Bash(genlock:*) did not, likely compound commands not matching the prefix rule
answers.absence: no denial seen after the fix yet; that is absence of evidence over minutes, not proof across days
answers.assumption: my assumption: Claude Code keeps honouring PreToolUse allow ahead of the auto-mode classifier in future versions; a deny rule in settings would still win
answers.falsify: a classifier denial on a genlock-only command in any transcript after 22:03 UTC 2026-11-13, or permissionDecisionMs >1000 on such a command
